text.offer: Drechx says, "Far'Nohl's knights swore to serve him beyond death, and they keep that oath still, in his chambers off the west end of the main hall. They are the finest fighters in that castle, captains among them. Free ten of them from their oath."
text.progress: The undead knights guard Far'Nohl's Chambers, through the door in the west wall of Castle Victoria's main hall.
text.complete: Ten oaths broken. They'll rest now, I hope.

steps.objective: Undead knights slain in Far'Nohl's Chambers
